question: Can I manually select which products are displayed in the Related Products Gallery in Wix Stores?
candidate_answer: No, you cannot manually select which products appear in the Related Products Gallery in Wix Stores. The gallery automatically shows products based on the same category, frequently bought together, or frequently viewed together data. Manual selection of related products is not supported at this time [S1].
contexts:
[1] Wix Stores Request: Manually Selecting Related Products
Currently, when you display a Related Products Gallery, you can choose whether it shows your customers other products from the same category, products frequently bought together (based on data), or frequently viewed together (based on data). It is not possible to hand pick which products are related to each store item.We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

[2] Wix Stores Request: Adding Etsy as a Sales Channel
Currently, selling your Wix Stores products through Etsy is not supported.   We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.
gt_answer: Currently, it is not possible to hand pick which products are related to each store item. When you display a [Related Products Gallery](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-adding-a-related-products-or-best-sellers-gallery), you can choose whether it shows your customers other products from the same category, products frequently bought together (based on data), or frequently viewed together (based on data).

question: What happened to the Wix Music distribution service and what are the alternatives for music distribution?
candidate_answer:
- Wix Music's distribution service ended on January 1st, 2019.
- To continue distributing music, users are recommended to use Soundrop, which is free and offers extensive distribution features across major platforms.
- Users will still receive outstanding payments for music sold through Wix distribution, with revenues typically released within 3-4 months of sale.
- For any issues related to previously distributed music, contacting Wix Support is advised [S1].
contexts:
[1] Wix Music: Distribution Service Has Ended
Wix Music's distribution service ended on January 1st, 2019. To continue distributing your music, you can check out Soundrop. Soundrop is free and has tons of cool distribution features across top platforms.Important:You will still receive  outstanding payments for any music you sold using Wix distribution. Most stores and services release revenues within 3-4 months of a sale. If you have any issues with your previously distributed music, contact Wix Support.

[2] Accessing and Reviewing Data From Your Wix Account and Sites
Music files: Music files that you uploaded to your site (e.g. MP3 files). Wix Music tracks: Music files that you uploaded to Wix Music.
gt_answer:
Wix Music's distribution service ended on January 1st, 2019. To continue distributing your music, you can check out [Soundrop](https://soundrop.com/). Soundrop is free and has tons of cool distribution features across top platforms.

### Important
* You will still receive outstanding payments for any music you sold using Wix distribution. Most stores and services release revenues within 3-4 months of a sale.
* If you have any issues with your previously distributed music, [contact Wix Support.](https://www.wix.com/contact/en)

question: Can I create more than 1000 product variants in Wix Stores?
candidate_answer: No, you cannot create more than 1000 product variants per product in Wix Stores. The current limit is up to 1000 variants per product, and this is a known restriction as per the latest workflow information [S1].
contexts:
[1] Wix Stores Request: Ability to Create over 1000 Product Variants
Currently, you can only create up to a total of 1000 variants per product.We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

[2] Desktop POS Request: Searching for Product Variants by SKU
Currently, when using POS Checkout to sell products on your desktop computer, you cannot search for product variants, when each variant has its own SKU.We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.
gt_answer: Currently, you can only create up to a total of 1000 variants per product.

question: How can I create a new album in the Shared Gallery app on my live site?
candidate_answer:
To create a new album in the Shared Gallery app on your live site, follow these steps:

- Go to the Shared Gallery section in your site's dashboard or directly on your live site.
- Log in with the email address associated with your Wix account.
- Click "Create Album."
- Enter a name and description for the album.
- Click the Add icon to upload a cover image.
- Click "Create Album" to finalize.

Note: You and any site visitor with Manage Gallery permissions can create albums. After creating your first album, all photos and videos will be organized into albums, and you can only add media to albums, not individually to the main gallery page [S1][S2].

question: Can I add drop-down or multiple choice options to the Wix Booking Form?
candidate_answer: No, you cannot add drop-down or multiple choice options to the Wix Booking Form at this time. The form only supports short text fields (up to 40 characters), paragraph fields (up to 255 characters), and checkbox fields. The platform is continuously being improved, and user feedback is encouraged for future updates [S1].
contexts:

Currently, you can add the following types of custom fields to your booking form: short text fields (up to 40 characters), paragraph fields (up to 255 characters), or checkbox fields. It is not currently possible to add other types of fields, such as drop-downs or multiple choice options. We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is greatly appreciated.

[2] Wix Bookings Request: Adding More than One Wix Bookings App to Your Site
Currently, it is not possible to add more than one Wix Bookings app to your site.Note:Therefore, it is currently not possible to create a multilingual booking site.We are always working to update and improve our products, and your feedback is hugely appreciated.

question: How can I redeem my 250 free business cards with the Wix Logo Maker plan?
candidate_answer:
To redeem your 250 free business cards with the Wix Logo Maker plan, follow these steps:

- Purchase an Unlimited or Business Wix Logo Maker plan to be eligible.
- Go to the Brand Studio in your Wix account.
- Click the "My Brands" drop-down at the top and select your relevant brand.
- Click "Brand Actions" and select "Print Logo on Merchandise."
- Click "Get Started" next to Business Cards.
- Choose a template by hovering over it and clicking "Select."
- Add your business details, then click "Save & Continue."
- Click "Add to Cart" — the business cards should be free (price 0) in the cart.
- Complete the checkout to have the double-sided cards shipped to your door.

Note: The free cards must be redeemed using the logo included in your purchased plan and cannot be transferred to another account or redeemed by collaborators [S1][S2].
